caption: The drawing features a single metal coffee pot with a long curved spout on the left and a large looping handle on the right. The body of the pot is conical and brown in color, with decorative elements. The lid and the base are both adorned with yellow-green curved patterns resembling leaves or petals. The central portion of the pot displays an oval decoration with stylized red and yellow flowers and swirling green stems against a dark green background, bordered by yellow-green leaf shapes. The spout, handle, and rim exhibit brown shading. The overall composition is centered on the page with a thin border outlining the drawing. At the lower left, there is a small ruler marked in inches, and at the lower right, the artist’s name "Mildred Ford" is written. The background of the drawing is an off-white, uncolored surface.
title: Toleware Coffee Pot
